title: NAZAR draft Wi-Fi Ear flow-bin record
description: Draft only. A possible approximately 100 ms per-flow metadata bin for phone-side analysis. This is not a frozen wire protocol and contains no payload data.

session_id.description: Ephemeral probe-session identifier; must not encode a room/person identity.

bin_start_monotonic_us.description: Monotonic timestamp in microseconds from a documented device clock; cross-device mapping is not specified.

bin_duration_ms.description: Proposed default is approximately 100 ms; final bin width requires E04 validation.

channel.description: Observed 802.11 channel; channel-plan validation is outside this schema.

flow_id.description: Opaque session-scoped flow identifier. Any raw transmitter/receiver address handling must be documented and minimized.

bytes_total.description: Sum of observed frame lengths in this flow/bin; no payload bytes or content.

rssi_mean_dbm.description: Mean RSSI for observed frames, or null when the bin has no measurement.

retry_frames.description: Count of frames marked as retries in this bin.

dropped_frame_count.description: Capture/drop count for interpreting missing observations; exact firmware semantics remain open.
